title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
SY405
Poverty
0.5 Credit
An examination of poverty as a social institution, social ideology and experienced reality. The
course
focuses on poverty as a social problem, including political and definitional debates and policy
attempts
at a response, both in the context of Canadian society and through consideration of selected cross-cultural case studies.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY210
(or SY204*) or
SY213
Exclusions
SY452c.
